status: PLAN ONLY - nothing generated; the build stage runs it
howToRun: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/image-plan.json --key-file <path outside the project> [--only id1,id2] [--dry]; loops: tools/hf-run.mjs then tools/make-loop.mjs per motion[] entry
rules: Every prompt: no text, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks or watermarks. fal flux still draws pseudo-text on eyeglass temples, lens edges, packaging and instrument dials (the Riverside run archived a frame with letter-like marks on a temple and rivets it was told not to draw) - so every image gets a full-size review: whole frame, then 100 and 400 percent crops of every temple, hinge, lens edge and any surface that could carry print.

No generated person stands in for an Academy Vision doctor, staff member or patient: no clinician faces, no white-coat portraits, alts never say "our". Generic, diverse models only where a person helps.
No stand-in for the Academy Vision building, roadside sign, murals or office interiors - no wide exam-room interiors either.
No medical-result, before/after or outcome depiction; no glucose readings, wounds or graphic eye conditions.
Cut-outs are reviewed on a magenta composite; shadows are added in CSS, never baked in.
Every generated file carries an AI label in its metadata/sidecar and an alt that describes what is depicted.

defaults.style: natural photographic realism, soft diffused daylight, calm, clean and modern, colour palette leaning to deep navy, soft mid blue, warm cream and white, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no brand marks, no watermarks
defaults.inputSource: these input keys, the 16:9 = 2752x1536 output size and the birefnet settings are the ones recorded in riversidefamilyeyecare-reforge/audit/generated-images.json and its image-plan.json defaults
